objective: Turn sports conversation into completed history imports, Deep Cut discovery, and shareable fan identity rather than posting generic matchup graphics.

measurement.privacyRule: Use aggregate UTM labels only. Never include a user ID, event ID, email, handle, or other personal data.

creativeRules.leagueScope: Every post has one subject league: nfl or sec_cfb. Audience voice never changes the subject league.
creativeRules.rights: Original Witnessed ticket geometry, typography, abstract stadium lines, and generic stat marks only.
forbidden: player or coach names or likenesses
stadium photography not owned by Bluebrook
imitations of a competitor's ticket skin
